issue.title: A Gmail Reply draft cannot be retargeted or discarded once the thread has newer messages
issue.description:
A saved Gmail note's Reply section cannot be retargeted or discarded once the thread has newer messages than the draft was built against.

- `bob gmail draft` fails `draft_reply_mismatch` (readback check in `src/native/gmail/compose/draft.rs`).
- `bob gmail reply` refuses while a Reply section exists (`ExistingReply`).
- After the Reply section is gone, leftover `gmail_draft_account` / `gmail_draft_remote_fingerprint` frontmatter fails `ConflictingDraftMarkers` (`validate_draft_metadata` in `source.rs`).

The only recovery is hand-editing managed frontmatter and the Reply section, which orphans the live Gmail draft. Agents never delete Gmail drafts, so the orphan stays until Bryan deletes it.

Reproduced on `mail/2026/261030_product_engineer.md`: the note still held a Nov 7 Reply (Gmail draft `1a1b57174c2c4da0`, marker `r-1329233658097418133`) whose `In-Reply-To` was Bryan's own Nov 6 message, while Bob's reply target is always the newest saved card (Dan's Nov 10 message `1a1c6d01cb332a28`). The To of that stale draft was Bryan himself. Resetting the note by deleting the two `gmail_draft_*` frontmatter lines and everything from `## Reply` onward was required before `bob gmail reply` returned `reply_added` against the Nov 10 message.

task_type_fields.impact: Stale Reply drafts stay pointed at older messages (sometimes To the account itself); recovery requires hand-editing managed frontmatter and orphans the Gmail draft because agents never delete drafts.
task_type_fields.repro: On a saved Gmail note whose newest card is newer than an existing Reply draft: run `bob gmail draft NOTE -f json` (expect `draft_reply_mismatch`); run `bob gmail reply NOTE -f json` (expect `ExistingReply`). Delete the Reply section but leave `gmail_draft_*` frontmatter, then `bob gmail reply` again (expect `ConflictingDraftMarkers`). Reproduction note: `mail/2026/261030_product_engineer.md` (do not quote message bodies).

issue.creation_reason: Found while drafting recruiter replies: Dan Dowd's saved thread had a stale Nov 7 Reply after a newer Nov 10 message, and Bob could neither retarget nor discard it without hand-editing managed mail-note metadata, which orphans the Gmail draft.
